title: FEMA reimbursement of county wildfire response costs
summary: As of November 2024, the county had received its first two FEMA reimbursement checks, totaling over $890,000, for fire department projects. FEMA sends the money to the state emergency agency, which passes it to the county. Police said FEMA had repaid a good portion of their fire costs, including all overtime, but some equipment requests missed the repayment deadline.

timeline.text: The managing director said full closeout of these repayments may take three to five years.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The managing director said about $2 to $3 million in public assistance (federal repayment for disaster damage) has already come to the county.
